notes.title: Golel Demo available now.
notes.content:
If you liked Golden Fall 2, please try out the Demo of Golel.

Golel is a first person Dungeon Crawler that can run on lower end PCs.
It is elaborating on turn based tactical combat in a way that hasn't been done a lot before.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2577730/Golel/

notes.title: Demo bug with keyboard not working, fixed.
notes.content:
I have fixed a bug in the Demo that wouldn't let you play the game without a gamepad attached.

As I transitioning into a new input system, which also support gamepad, these bugs appeared.
The full version will get the new Input System with gamepad support soon.
I hope no serious issues there as well.

Working Demo version is 1.4

notes.title: Version 1.075.
notes.content:
Version 1.075 is released.

Important bug fix:
* Fixed dialogs bugs in 4k resolution(UHD).

And a few other small bug fixes.

notes.title: Version 1.07 improves bonuses to weapons.
notes.content:
Version 1.07 brings a few important fixes/improvements.

[olist]
[*]You now have an Attributes Bonuses window, that can be extended from the character window.
This tells you which bonuses you get from your attributes.
[*]There is now more than one bonus path for swords. Existing path relied on Int as well as Dex and Str.
There is a new path that rely on Dex and Str alone.
You get the higher out of the two paths.
[*]Small important fix. You can now pick up gold even if your backpack is full.
[/olist]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37477401/88b37eecdbf2a99872f4c7ea1183e40e0ae078bb.png[/img]

notes.title: Golden Fall 2 Released today!
notes.content:
[h1]Golden Fall 2 has released![/h1]

Golden Fall 2 is finally released.

The game contains 10 hand tailored levels that can be passed with several playing styles.

You will have to solve riddles, find hidden treasures, buy special weapons and equipment, fight monsters, fight BIG monsters, and make friends on the way.


[h2]10% off Release Sale![/h2]
Golden Fall 2's price is 6 USD, and is on Sale for 10% of for it's release.

notes.title: Golden Fall 2 might release soon.
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

This is Ofer, the developer of Golden Fall 2.

[h2]Annoucement[/h2]
I am happy to announce that all 10 levels of Golden Fall 2 are done.
The final boss is the pinnacle of the game, I have tested it with the warrior and wizard build, and it's really fun.

I still have work. Fixing issues, Polishing, Translations. 
However, gameplay wise, the game is 99% complete.

[h2]What's coming soon[/h2]
I don't want to set anything in stone, but these are what I think is predicted.

The game will consist of 10 levels of varying lengths.
It will cost 6USD. 
It is expected to be released within the next 3 months, maybe even earlier.

You will traverse many types of environment. Hot and cold. Outdoor and inside deep dungeons.
You will meet many friendly characters on the way. And there will be many ferocious enemies.
Also there are going to be quite some riddles.

Regarding the translation, at first there might be only English and Hebrew. I will make an effort to translate to other languages as well though.

[h2]Reviews by your favourite reviewer[/h2]
I would like you to post a reply, which reviewer you would like to review the game.
If you don't mind, you can also try to ask that reviewer to contact me. That might help, but it's not required.
I will try to get a review from the reviewers you will post here.

I will also open a discussion in the community about which reviewers you want to see review the game.

[h2]Discussion to post the reviewers you want to see.[/h2]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1292410/discussions/0/3111396383962023655/

[h3]
Any question you have, ask here or in the discussions.
Or in my support email.[/h3]

support@pompipompi.zendesk.com

notes.title: Version 1.09 consists many improvement and new Achievements.
notes.content:
Version 1.09 is out, and with it a lot of improvements.
In terms of the gameplay, it is more or less the same, apart from a few changes to the enemy AI.

There are performance improvements, visuals improvements, two new Heroes, two new Achievements corresponding, better GUI and audio.
You can now also activate skills using 1, 2, 3, 4, in your keyboard.

Please let me know if any bugs/issues/feedback.

Here you can discuss if you don't like the fact that I added new achievements, or if you actually like it:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1292410/discussions/0/4098792306723042477/

For the bugs and reports, discuss here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1292410/discussions/0/2268068817156930500/

You can try and help me out and tell me how to spread the word about this game.

notes.title: Version 1.06 Windows update.
notes.content:
Version 1.06 changes the following:
1) Fix AI issues when enemies would stop to chase you beyond opened gate.
2) Enemy now goes back to wander if it cannot reach the player.
3) Fixed bug when you stand on a door tile you cannot hit or get hit by enemies.
4) Cleave now hits 4 enemies in an L shape. 

Hopefully no new bugs are introduced.

notes.title: Golden Fall 2 Demo now supports Polish, German, French, Spanish and Japanese.
notes.content:
Golden Fall 2 Demo now supports Polish, German, French, Spanish and Japanese in addition to the previous languages of:
Thai, Brazillian, Chinese, Hebrew and Russian.

Please try out the Demo in your favorite language!

Are there any other languages you would like me to add?
Please tell me so.

Also, comment if the translation seem a bit off to you.

notes.title: Demo translated to: Thai, PTBR, Hebrew, Russian, Simplified Chinese.
notes.content:
I have added support for localization, and the new languages the game is completely translated to are:
Thai, PTBR, Hebrew, Russian, Simplified Chinese.

Notice game size have increased by about 150MB on disk due to that.
So now game size is about 300MB.

If you find any bugs, characters not showing, or any other issue. 
Please report here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1292410/discussions/0/2268068817156930500/

notes.title: Chat with the Developer
notes.content:
Hi,

My name is Ofer.

Please join me on the game's Steam group chat:
IMPORTANT! Since Steam's group chat stopped working, I will also be on Discord:

https://discord.gg/2SzHur
